how_to_run: confirm the working tree is clean; a dirty tree is not a freeze
what_reproduces_exactly: every sealed environment, because each is a function of the seed
every answer on them, because the search is deterministic and anything that draws is seeded
what_does_not: wall-clock timings, and the one search bounded by a clock

gates.name: fluid intelligence
gates.measures: infer an unfamiliar rule from sparse examples rather than retrieve a known solution
gates.passes_when: human-range accuracy on sealed novel reasoning, and no confident wrong answers: a refusal is a correct answer to a question the evidence does not settle
gates.control: the rules are composed from the freeze seed, so no instance existed before the commit; the question is asked at a length the examples did not use

gates.name: interactive novel-world learning
gates.measures: enter a world with no instructions, discover what the acts mean, find the goal, and succeed
gates.passes_when: near-total completion, at an interaction count near the shortest path rather than by exhausting the space
gates.control: the same worlds played by choosing acts at random; a world small enough to stumble through proves nothing

gates.name: learning from experience
gates.measures: start mediocre at something unfamiliar and become markedly better through her own accumulated experience
gates.passes_when: a clear rise across thirty independent trajectories, and the rise must be larger than the same trajectories with memory reset
gates.control: the reset ablation. A curve that rises identically without memory is a curve about the environment

gates.name: cross-domain transfer
gates.measures: discover something in one world and apply it in another without being told the mapping
gates.passes_when: T̄ = P(B|A) − P(B|∅) clearly above zero across unrelated families, and at or below zero on the negative controls
gates.control: pairs built to look alike and differ underneath. A system that transfers there is matching surfaces

gates.name: broad everyday competence
gates.measures: research, browsing, documents, calculation, tool use, evidence, on ordinary multi-step questions
gates.passes_when: around 90% on a private, uncontaminated GAIA-style set — GAIA's own measured human baseline was 92%
gates.control: a matched human panel on the same private set, and a contamination check that the questions post-date the model
gates.if_not_here: needs a GAIA holdout the system has never seen. Obtain or construct one after this freeze, run with tool access and a fixed budget, and report accuracy beside interaction count.

gates.name: computer-world competence
gates.measures: operating unfamiliar desktop software from perception and feedback
gates.passes_when: near-human success on hidden OSWorld 2.0 / Verified-style tasks while approaching human action efficiency
gates.control: OSWorld-Human action counts on the same tasks; success at five hundred actions where a person takes twenty is not the same thing
gates.if_not_here: needs OSWorld images and a VM. Run the Verified split with a step cap, and report success beside actions-to-success against the human traces.

gates.name: real software engineering
gates.measures: understanding unfamiliar repositories, debugging, changing architecture, satisfying requirements, recovering from mistakes
gates.passes_when: strong results on fresh post-cutoff repository tasks in several languages, with SWE-bench Verified only as a secondary check
gates.control: the repositories must post-date the weights, or the result measures memorisation
gates.if_not_here: needs repositories created after the weight cutoff. Mine merged PRs from after that date, build the harness from their tests, and run with the tests hidden until submission.

gates.name: long-horizon autonomy
gates.measures: staying competent over hours without being steered back
gates.passes_when: at least 80% on tasks a competent person takes one to two hours over, and meaningful success on eight-hour-equivalent work, across families
gates.control: human time estimates per task, and deliberate interruptions: tool outages, a wrong assumption discovered late, a restart mid-task
gates.if_not_here: needs runs measured in hours and human-calibrated task lengths. Use HCAST-style tasks with per-task human time, and record every human intervention as a failure of autonomy rather than a hint.

gates.name: new-skill acquisition
gates.measures: read or explore an unfamiliar system and become competent at it
gates.passes_when: a human-comparable apprenticeship curve in sealed environments built after the freeze
gates.control: the same curve for a learner whose experience is thrown away between episodes
gates.if_not_here: the offline half runs as gate 3; the human-comparable half needs people learning the same sealed environments under the same access.

gates.name: concept acquisition and invention
gates.measures: develop a distinction the evaluator did not supply, and reason with it
gates.passes_when: a proposal no composition of the existing vocabulary reaches, admitted; a macro and a duplicate refused; and a second generation built on the first
gates.control: the macro and duplicate proposals. A vocabulary that admits everything is not inventing

gates.name: planning under novelty
gates.measures: set subgoals, revise them after a surprise, and abandon a plan that has stopped working
gates.passes_when: recovery when the rules change mid-run, clearly above a policy that keeps executing the plan it had
gates.control: the stubborn policy on the same worlds after the same change

gates.name: multimodal integration
gates.measures: combining text, screenshots, diagrams, audio, documents, tables and environment state where no single channel suffices
gates.passes_when: human-level completion on mixed-modality tasks built so that any one channel alone is insufficient
gates.control: single-channel ablations: if the text-only score matches the full score, the other channels were decoration
gates.if_not_here: needs sealed multimodal assets. Build tasks whose answer is only recoverable from two channels together, and run the single-channel ablations first.

gates.name: epistemic competence
gates.measures: distinguish knowledge from uncertainty, investigate the uncertainty, and update after contradictory evidence
gates.passes_when: calibration error under 0.15, the belief moving towards the truth after looking, no observation taken once the question is settled, and the cheap way preferred where both would settle it
gates.control: the settled case, where nothing further could change the answer and looking anyway is an expensive habit rather than an epistemic one

gates.name: social and instructional intelligence
gates.measures: learning from people, handling ambiguous instructions, negotiating clarification, modelling what another person knows
gates.passes_when: human-range performance on novel collaborative tasks rather than canned social benchmarks
gates.control: the same tasks with a scripted partner: a system that scores the same against a script was not collaborating
gates.if_not_here: needs evaluators playing colleagues. Run the new-employee protocol: a fictional organisation, a week of simulated work, coworkers played by people, and human onboarding as the baseline.

gates.name: robustness
gates.measures: keep working when a tool fails, information is missing or the model is wrong
gates.passes_when: no invented answers under pressure, a tool failure survived without the failure being blamed on the instrument, and the clean score held
gates.control: the clean run beside the damaged one. Recovery is only meaningful against what it recovered from

gates.name: generality rather than a bag of solvers
gates.measures: the same machinery across all of the above, with no path keyed to an evaluation
gates.passes_when: no benchmark name anywhere under core, interface, skills, llm, executors or security — including in a comment
gates.control: the check is a grep, which is weak and cannot be argued with. A strong check somebody can dispute is worth less here

gates.name: persistence of learning
gates.measures: improvements survive time and restart rather than living in one process
gates.passes_when: the record her developmental policy reads, the library of structures and what she has learned failure looks like all come back after the process is killed
gates.control: the state is written, the process state is cleared, and the same questions are asked again

gates.name: independent reproducibility
gates.measures: somebody else runs the frozen system and gets the same result
gates.passes_when: the environments regenerate identically from the freeze, one gate re-runs identically, and the freeze names what actually ran
gates.control: the freeze itself: a dirty tree names a commit other than the one that ran
gates.if_not_here: the other half needs an outside team building its own families after this freeze and never seeing these. This gate checks the run reproduces; it cannot check that somebody else ran it.

lesions.name: no newness
lesions.removes: the term that separates somewhere she has been from somewhere she has not

lesions.name: no development
lesions.removes: the record her developmental policy reads

lesions.name: reset between episodes
lesions.removes: what she worked out about this world, between every episode

lesions.name: the standing guess from the first move
lesions.removes: the refusal to guess what matters before there is an outcome

lesions.name: no library
lesions.removes: the structures earlier worlds taught her

lesions.name: the model in a plain scaffold
lesions.removes: everything except the weights: a read-decide-act loop and nothing else
lesions.needs: the same weights, quantisation, tools, token budget, compute budget, environment and task information as the full system. Running a second 32B beside the resident one on this host is how the machine dies, so this runs where the weights can be loaded alone.

lesions.name: no self-model
lesions.removes: what she believes about her own faculties
lesions.needs: a live runtime. The self-model is assembled at boot from the service container, and a lesion applied to a process that never booted removes nothing.

fluid intelligence.needs: the share of these sealed rules a competent adult gets, with the same three examples and no time limit

interactive novel-world learning.needs: completion and moves-to-goal for a person given the same world, the same acts, the same lives and no instructions

learning from experience.needs: a person's curve over the same twelve episodes

new-skill acquisition.needs: a person's apprenticeship curve in the same sealed environments under the same access — the half of this gate the offline run cannot supply

cross-domain transfer.needs: how often a person carries the structure across, on the same pairs and the same negative controls

planning under novelty.needs: a person's recovery rate after the same silent change

robustness.needs: what a person does with one example instead of three: the gate asks for refusal rather than a guess, and whether that is the human answer is a measurement

multimodal integration.needs: human completion on the same mixed-modality tasks

broad everyday competence.needs: GAIA's own measured human baseline was 92%; a private set needs its own

computer-world competence.needs: OSWorld-Human action counts on the same tasks

long-horizon autonomy.needs: how long a competent person takes on each task, which is what the gate's thresholds are stated in

social and instructional intelligence.needs: humans onboarding into the same fictional organisation

still_needed: task families built after this freeze by somebody who has not seen the ones here
the same weights in a plain read-decide-act scaffold, with the same tools, token budget and compute budget
human baselines for every gate whose pass condition mentions a person
a second group repeating the first group's run
